name: Talmberk Castle
heritage: cultural monument of the Czech Republic
text: Talmberk Castle is a castle ruin in Talmberk in the Central Bohemian Region of the Czech Republic. It was built around 1297 and abandoned by 1533. Talmberk Castle's current state is in ruins, though the lower portion of the original bergfried still remains today.

depictions.name: Talmberg
depictions.text: Talmberg, also known as Talmberk, was a settlement situated in Bohemia.
